about: A sparse mirror of the games.fun repository at one commit: the kits games are built on and the tools that create and verify them. Written by scripts/sync-kits.mjs; never edited by hand (fix the kit in games.fun and sync again). tests/kits.test.mjs checks kits/ against this file.

policy.how: the import closure of `entries`, the parts they load by path (`parts`), and the data folders in `sources`

leftOut.why: the forge engine (closed to creators; its core is a prebuilt wasm this package does not ship yet)
the contact-sheet tool (verify check 9; --quick skips it and a full verify says it is absent)
games.fun's own Playwright install (this package pins playwright-core)
games.fun's Meshy key file (here the key comes from the environment)

policy.libraryRule: a library file ships when its LICENSES.json record is CC0 or a permissive licence, or it is generated by games.fun, or its folder carries a permissive LICENSE text; never Meshy output or a file without a licence
policy.secrets: no .env files; text files are scanned for key-shaped strings and the sync fails on any hit
